title: Legacy 'Time Clock' users become 'Time Clock User' after migration
preconds:
1. Migration to the new roles is complete.
  2. At least one existing 'Time Clock' user is present.
steps:
1. Go to Settings > Staff and find a 'Time Clock' user.
  2. Check the user's assigned role.
  3. Go to Settings > Roles & Permissions and find that role's row.
  4. Look at the role's read-only Permission Summary (eye icon).
expected:
The user's role is 'Time Clock User'.

The role's permissions match the expected set for that role.

The 'Time Clock User' role cannot be edited (it shows a lock and only the eye icon).

The role shows as 'Time Clock User' (renamed from 'Time Clock').

Logged in as this user, only clock in / out is reachable; every top-navigation item is hidden or refused.
